description: Defines an abstract base class 'BaseRoutingStrategy' for managing routing strategies involving Redis and in-memory caching, including batch incrementing, periodic synchronization, and cleanup operations.

classes.name: BaseRoutingStrategy
classes.description: An abstract base class providing common functionality for routing strategies that involve batching Redis increments, in-memory cache synchronization, and periodic updates in multi-instance environments.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the routing strategy with cache, batching options, and sync interval.

methods.name: setup_sync_task
methods.description: Sets up an asyncio task for periodic synchronization with Redis.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cancels the sync task during shutdown.

methods.name: _increment_value_list_in_current_window
methods.description: Increments a list of key-value pairs within the current window.

methods.name: _increment_value_in_current_window
methods.description: Increments a single key's value within the current window, updating in-memory cache and queue.

methods.name: periodic_sync_in_memory_spend_with_redis
methods.description: Periodically synchronizes in-memory cache with Redis based on the sync interval.

methods.name: _push_in_memory_increments_to_redis
methods.description: Pushes batched increments from in-memory to Redis, compressing multiple operations for the same key.

methods.name: add_to_in_memory_keys_to_update
methods.description: Adds a key to the set of keys to be synchronized.

methods.name: get_key_pattern_to_sync
methods.description: Returns the key pattern for synchronization (default None).

methods.name: get_in_memory_keys_to_update
methods.description: Returns the set of keys marked for update.

methods.name: get_and_reset_in_memory_keys_to_update
methods.description: Atomically retrieves and resets the set of keys to update.

methods.name: reset_in_memory_keys_to_update
methods.description: Resets the set of keys to update.

methods.name: _sync_in_memory_spend_with_redis
methods.description: Ensures in-memory cache is synchronized with Redis, including pushing increments and merging values.
